response.answer: To register a moped (limited use motorcycle) in New York, you must have a driver license and register it to drive on streets and highways. You cannot operate it on a sidewalk. Bring to the DMV: a completed Registration/Title Application (MV-82), proof of ownership, proof of identity and age (you must be at least 16), proof of insurance if required, and payment for fees and sales tax. The class (A, B, or C) is determined by top speed, and only certified models can be registered. For quicker service, make a reservation online before visiting offices in certain counties.

# Register a moped

## Register a moped [1]

## What is considered a limited use motorcycle (aka moped )?

New York law defines limited use motorcycles, which are commonly called "mopeds" or "motor scooters", as "limited use vehicles with two or three wheels.”

## Are there any special requirements to operate a limited use motorcycle (moped) in New York?

## The requirements to operate a moped are like those for motorcycles. You must have a driver

license and register your moped to drive it on streets and highways. There are exceptions to these requirements listed in the table below. You can never operate a moped down a sidewalk.The DMV classifies a moped as a Class A, Class B or Class C limited use motorcycle according to its top speed. Only a certified model of limited use motorcycle can get a registration in New York State (only the manufacturer can certify a moped).

## What do | need to bring to the DMV?

Before visiting a DMV office [2] to register your moped, please complete the Document Guide to make sure you bring the correct documents with you.

Find your proofs [3]

## Summary of what you need

a completed Registration / Title Application (PDF) [4] (MV-82)

proof of ownership [5]

proof of identity and age 1

proof of insurance, if required 2

cash, check, money order or credit/debit card for fees and sales tax [6] (or proof of sales tax payment or exemption)

For quicker service, make a reservation online before visiting offices in New York City, Westchester, Nassau, Suffolk, Rockland, Onondaga, Monroe or Albany Counties. For all other counties, see our office locations and hours [2].

Make a Reservation [7]

The class is determined by the range of the vehicle's top speed.

- 1. You must be at least 16 years old to register a vehicle in New York (except a boat or ATV). ANY State Driver License, Learner Permit, or Non-Driver ID card that is current or not expired for more than 2 years can serve as proof of both identity and age. If you don t have one of these documents, you must provide other kinds of proof [8].

-2.

Refer to the Limited-use motorcycle requirements chart on this page to determine if you need insurance. Your insurance company will issue proof of insurance by giving you two original barcoded NY State Insurance Identification Cards (see sample), You must register your vehicle at the DMV within 180 days of the effective date on your insurance ID card. Bring one copy of your Insurance Identification Cards with you. The DMV office will keep it. Keep the other card with the vehicle as your proof of insurance. Learn more about NY State Insurance Requirements [9].

- 3. Learner permit restrictions apply to all permit classes. Junior operator restrictions apply to class DJ and MJ permits and driver licenses. See information about the Graduated License Law [10].

- 4. Learner permit restrictions apply to all permit classes. Junior operator restrictions apply to class DJ and MJ permits and driver licenses. See information about the Graduated License Law [10].

- 5. Learner permit restrictions apply to all permit classes. Junior operator restrictions apply to class DJ and MJ permits and driver licenses. See information about the Graduated License Law [10].

- 6. Except when making a left turn.

- 7. Except when making a left turn.

- 8. AClass C moped used as a rental vehicle must be insured.

- Registration [11]

### 更多帮助

请参阅《车辆注册/所有权申请说明》（PDF）（MV-82.1）。

有关注册不同类型车辆的具体信息，请参阅本页列出的网页。

您无需是美国居民即可在纽约注册车辆

只要您满足注册要求，就可以在这里注册车辆。

关于车辆或摩托车上的车辆识别号码（VIN）

为了保护消费者，DMV 希望告知您纽约州关于车辆识别号码（也称为 VIN）的法律。

加利福尼亚州排放标准

大多数车辆必须符合加利福尼亚州排放标准。

共享注册信息

了解更多关于共享您的信息的内容。

没有找到您要找的内容？

查找有关车辆注册的其他信息。

- 1.

您的保险公司将：

1\) 给您 2 张带有条形码的纽约州保险 ID 卡原件（参见示例），或让您访问您的数字电子纽约州保险 ID 卡

2\) 向 DMV 发送电子保险通知（您的保险代理人或经纪人不能提交此通知）

您的纽约州保险 ID 卡和电子通知共同证明您的保险范围。我们需要两者。

您必须在保险 ID 卡上的生效日期起 180 天内注册您的车辆。随身携带一份您的保险 ID 卡副本或形式。DMV 办公室将保留纸质卡。将另一张纸质卡放在车内作为您的保险证明。任何操 作您车辆的人都必须能够提供保险证明。

了解更多关于纽约州保险要求的信息。

- 2. **Cars, trucks, trailers & motorcycles**

Model year 1973 or newer, either

- NY State Certificate of Title (original or certified copy, not a photocopy) with the transfer ownership section completed by the seller, or

- - acceptable proof of ownership from another state (original or certified copy, not a photocopy)

Model year 1972 or older, either

- a NY State Transferable Registration (original or certified copy, not a photocopy) and bill of sale, or

- - acceptable proof of ownership from another state (original or certified copy, not a photocopy)

See acceptable proofs for other vehicles (manufactured homes, boats, ATVs, snowmobiles, gifted vehicles, vehicles with deceased owners).

- 3.

Your insurance company will:

1\) give you 2 barcoded original NY State Insurance ID cards (see a sample) or provide you with access to your digital electronic NY State Insurance ID Card

2\) send an electronic notice of insurance coverage to the DMV (your insurance agent or broker cannot file this notice)

Your NY State Insurance ID cards and the electronic notice together verify your coverage. We need both.

You must register your vehicle within 180 days of the effective date on your Insurance ID Card. Bring one copy or form of your Insurance ID Card with you. The DMV office will keep the paper card. Keep the other paper card with the vehicle as your proof of insurance. Anyone operating your vehicle must be able to provide proof of insurance.

Learn more about NY State Insurance Requirements.

- 4.

Bill of sale

You can use the Vehicle Bill of Sale (PDF) (MV-912) form, or create one that includes the

- vehicle year and make

- - vehicle ID number (VIN) or hull ID (HIN)

- - date of the sale

- - purchase price

- - names and signatures of buyer and seller

Make copies for your records. Give the original bill to DMV. A bill of sale is not an acceptable without other proofs of ownership. You need a bill of sale even if got the vehicle as a gift.

#### 销售税支付

如果您在私人交易中从他人处购买了车辆，您（买方）和卖方都必须填写（纽约州税务与财政局） （DTF-802）表格。DMV 计算税额并出具付款收据。

- 如果您在购买车辆时不是纽约州居民，请使用《销售和使用税豁免申请——车辆所有权/注册、拖车 、全地形车（ATV）、船只（船舶）或雪地摩托》（销售税表格）（PDF）（纽约州税务与财政局 ）（DTF-803）以获得纽约州销售税的非居民豁免。DTF-803 定义了“非居民”和“居民”。

- 5.

您必须提供身份和出生日期证明。您必须年满16岁（ATV和船只注册除外）。

#### 您可以使用纽约州

- 驾驶执照

- - 学习许可证，或

- - 非驾驶员身份证

（当前有效或过期不超过2年）作为身份和年龄证明。如果您没有这些证件，请参阅其他可使用的 证明类型。

- 6. 请参阅《车辆注册/所有权申请说明》（PDF）（MV-82.1）。

- 7. 延期贴纸允许您在注册日期起10天内让车辆在纽约接受检查。任何由前注册人获得的纽约州 或外州检查在车辆注册到您名下后均无效。您必须让车辆接受检查。

# 买卖车辆（转移所有权）

### 转移所有权

#### 在购买车辆前确定你确切需要什么

使用 DMV 的 Document Guide 确保你从卖方那里获得所有需要的文件，以便在纽约注册你的车辆。

查找你的证明 [1]

#### 一般来说，当转移所有权时...

卖方必须要么

- 填写并签署 title certificate 的转移所有权部分，并且
- 签署 bill of sale [2]（即使是赠与）

要么

- 提供其他可接受的所有权和转移所有权证明 [3]

买方必须

- 签署 bill of sale [2]（即使是赠与）
- 支付 sales tax [4] 或有免税证明
- 注册并为车辆或 trailer [5]（或 snowmobile、boat、moped 或 ATV [6]）上牌，或将他们拥有的另一辆车的 registration [7] 转移到新车上

### 所有权证明

在纽约注册和上牌车辆所需的所有权证明因车辆类型（例如，汽车、拖车、船只、雪地摩托、活动房屋）而异。

- 可接受的所有权证明 [3]
- 在购买时获取所有权证明 [8]
- 已故车主 [9]
- 购买时的所有权证明 [8]
- 无法获得所有权证明 [10]

### 如何注册

查看关于如何注册你购买（或作为礼物收到）的车辆的信息。

- 注册并为车辆或 trailer 上牌 [5]
- [6]注册 snowmobile、boat 或 ATV [6]
- 将 registration 转移到你拥有的另一辆车 [7]
- 如果你没有 title，如何注册新购买的车辆 [11]

您必须在DMV办公室登记车辆。不能通过电话、在线或邮寄方式办理。

### 附加信息

#### 更改姓名

您不能将车辆登记或所有权证书上的姓名更改为他人的姓名。您必须转移车辆所有权。

#### 水淹损坏

您可以查询National Insurance Crime Bureau数据库[12]以查看车辆是否遭受水淹损坏。您需要车辆识别号码（VIN）。

#### 购车提示

请阅读DMV宣传册《Let the Buyer Be Aware》[13]和《Q&A About Your Title Certificate》[14]。

parsed.answer: To register a moped (limited use motorcycle) in New York, you must have a driver license and register it to drive on streets and highways. You cannot operate it on a sidewalk. Bring to the DMV: a completed Registration/Title Application (MV-82), proof of ownership, proof of identity and age (you must be at least 16), proof of insurance if required, and payment for fees and sales tax. The class (A, B, or C) is determined by top speed, and only certified models can be registered. For quicker service, make a reservation online before visiting offices in certain counties.
